title: Fix Discrepancy in Class Reference for Area2D|3D
body:
### Godot Version 4.4.1 stable

### Issue description

The following wording appears throughout several methods:

`get_overlapping_areas`
> the list of overlapping areas is modified once during the physics step

`has_overlapping_areas`
> list of overlaps is updated once per frame and before the physics step

The code shows that both methods refer to the same underlying property: `area_map`.

Before checking the code, I assumed the different wording was purposeful, especially when they seem to be calculated at different times.

### Proposal
1. Correct whichever methods are wrong about the timing
2. Unify the wording of these methods so it is clear they refer to the same thing:
    - Replace use of `overlaps` with the explicitly clear `overlapping_areas`.
    - Use _modified_ or _updated_, but not both.
3. Make the same fixes for functions involving `overlapping_bodies`

### Lines Referenced
Here's a few of lines referenced, I won't cover them all but you get the gist.
